faqs.a:
A warrant may be issued by the city municipal court to search any person or premises
               within the city upon a showing of probable cause that a distraint warrant has been
               issued by the finance director, that property subject to the distraint warrant is
               located on the premises and that the distraint warrant cannot reasonably be satisfied
               exclusively by the seizure of property located in a place not subject to a reasonable
               expectation of privacy. The procedure for issuance, execution and motions for return
               of property, shall be as provided in Municipal Court Rule of Procedure 241(c), (d)
               and (e). Nothing in this rule shall be construed to require a search warrant in any
               case where warrants are not presently required by law.
(Code 1981, § 31-69; Ord. No. 3783, § 2, 12-16-2002)
